about_the_game:
Battle for Randland is the official Wheel of Time digital trading card game. Build powerful decks, master unique factions, and battle players worldwide in strategic, turn-based matches. Step into Randland, a world of magic, prophecy, and political intrigue. Choose your allegiance, command legendary characters and spells, and shape the fate of the world.

Align yourself with one of the great powers of Randland. From the White Tower to the Borderlands, from the Aiel to the Seanchan Empire, each faction offers unique cards, abilities, and strategies rooted in the lore of the Wheel of Time.

Collect and master a vast library of cards inspired by the characters, magic, and history of the Wheel of Time. Combine leaders, companions, spells, and artifacts to create powerful decks that match your preferred playstyle.

Battle across a stunning 3D board brought to life with animated companions and magical effects. Experience an immersive visual style that captures the grandeur and danger of the Wheel of Time universe.

Engage in intense online PvP and test your skills in competitive matches. Experiment with countless deck combinations, adapt to your opponent’s tactics, and prepare for the upcoming 2v2 mode.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 (2GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 64-bit or SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
